manual.industrial_fluids.line1: In the Valley of the Drums
manual.industrial_fluids.line2: {0}§lCreosote Oil§r is a thick, viscous fluid that comes from the destructive pyrolysis of §lCoal§r into {1}Coal Coke{2}.{3}
manual.industrial_fluids.line3: It is used for a variety of products including {0}Treated Wood{1} and can be burnt in the {2}Diesel Generator{3}.{4}
manual.industrial_fluids.line4: {0}§lRedstone Acid§r is a powerful acid produced by dissolving the acidic salt redstone in water.{1}
manual.industrial_fluids.line5: While the exact properties of Redstone remain a mystery even to the most studied engineers, it behaves as an electrolyte incredibly favorably.{0}
manual.industrial_fluids.line6: {0}The acid is not strong enough to dissolve organic matter, but it is mildly corrosive to metal and acts as an excellent electrolyte for {1}Accumulators{2}.{3}
manual.industrial_fluids.line7: For mass production, the acid can be easily created in a {0}Mixer{1}, using 1 piece of §2Redstone Dust§r for one quarter of a bucket of water.{2}
manual.industrial_fluids.line8: {0}When used in a {1}Chemical Thrower{2} or in a {3}Bottling Machine{4} it can be used to oxidize copper blocks.{5}
manual.industrial_fluids.line9: The bottling recipe consumes an eighth of a bucket for each block oxidized.{0}
manual.industrial_fluids.line10: {0}§lPlant Oil§r and §lEthanol§r are plant-derived fuels primarily used in {1}Biodiesel{2}.{3}
manual.industrial_fluids.line11: Ethanol can also be used as a precursor to {0}Acetaldehyde{1}. Plant Oil can also be used to lubricate the bearings of large tools.{2}
manual.industrial_fluids.line12: {0}§lBiodiesel§r is the great prime mover of any aspiring industrial engineer, and created from {1}Plant Oil and Ethanol{2} in the {3}Refinery{4}.{5}
manual.industrial_fluids.line13: When burned in the {0}Diesel Generator{1}, biodiesel will produce truly industrial amounts of power.{2}
manual.industrial_fluids.line14: {0}To increase the energy output of §lBiodiesel§r further, it can be combined with a {1}Potion of Strength{2} in the {3}Refinery{4} at 95 to 5 ratio. The resulting §lHigh-Cetane Biodiesel§r has a 25% longer burn time!{5}
manual.industrial_fluids.line15: {0}§lPhenolic Resin§r and §lAcetaldehyde§r are primary constituents of the plastic {1}Duroplast{2}.{3}
manual.industrial_fluids.line16: The recipes for production involving these chemical precursors can be found {0}in later sections{1}.{2}
manual.industrial_fluids.line17: {0}§lHerbicide§r is a chemical with rather poisonous effects to local plant life.{1}
manual.industrial_fluids.line18: When loaded into a {0}Chemical Thrower{1} it is dispersed as a fine mist, which withers and destroys any plants it comes in contact with.{2}
manual.industrial_fluids.line19: {0}The fluid will remove leaves from trees, destroy flowers, bushes and crops and strip the grass from dirt. It will also dehydrate and ruin farmland.{1}
manual.industrial_fluids.line20: To craft Herbicide, mix half a bucket of {0}Ethanol{1} with §2Copper Dust§r and §2Sulfur Dust§r in the {2}Mixer{3}.{4}
manual.industrial_fluids.line21: {0}§lPotions§r can be bucketed and produced en masse using the {1}Mixer{2}.{3}
manual.industrial_fluids.line22: This allows for the production of buffs without the use of copious amounts of §lBlaze Powder§r and at a higher efficiency.
